mission: Activate bounded source-span semantic support in live adaptive worker scoring and isolate shared infrastructure failures from worker-template learning.

worker_learning_contract.source_support_pass: Worker scoring proceeds when every observed claim is supported by its resolved immutable span.
worker_learning_contract.claim_semantics_failure: Quality and benefit are capped; next action is TIGHTEN_SEMANTIC_SUPPORT.
worker_learning_contract.evidence_resolution_failure: Worker template is preserved; next action is HOLD_TEMPLATE_REPAIR_EVIDENCE.
worker_learning_contract.shared_infrastructure_failure: Performance is invalid; topology is held; next action is HOLD_TEMPLATE_INFRA; sentinel zeroes are excluded from learning history.

truth_boundary: Semantic support is a conservative claim-to-immutable-span relation, not an external-world truth verdict. Infrastructure classification establishes that template scoring is invalid for the observed uniform provider/runtime failure, not the provider's ultimate root cause.
next_gate: Run Turn 7 with real healthy worker telemetry; tune semantic recall/precision and provider resilience as separate experimental variables.
